_comment: AR Collections Agent runtime config. Every threshold lives here, so product or finance staff can change them without touching code.

tiering._comment: Product spec §4 tiering decision matrix. Any high condition -> high risk; otherwise any mid condition -> medium; otherwise any overdue invoice -> light.

cadence._comment: Follow-up cadence for the light tier; account-manager buffer for the medium tier.

policy._comment: L4 runtime policy layer. Hard rules, independent of the LLM and any system prompt; they apply on a match and cannot be bypassed.

channels._comment: With live=false everything is dry-run: messages are only written to data/outbox/ and never sent. Setting true also needs .env credentials and AR_LIVE=1 (two gates).

llm._comment: Only used for the contact-history summary in high-risk alerts; takes no part in any decision. provider: none | ollama | anthropic; the AR_LLM_PROVIDER / AR_LLM_MODEL environment variables override it. Falls back to the raw records on failure or if the check fails.
